answer_1.quote: We evaluate our framework on the RealTravel dataset, demonstrating its effectiveness in generating high-quality travel plans... Our approach demonstrates superior constraint satisfaction compared to baseline methods.
answer_1.outputs: travel itineraries in structured JSON format

answer_2.quote: We assess metrics such as Delivery Rate, Commonsense Constraint Pass Rate, Hard Constraint Pass Rate, Final Pass Rate and Preference Rate to evaluate the generated plans.

answer_3.quote: We leverage the 'LLM as judge' paradigm, where a large language model assesses travel plans based on user preference alignment, providing an objective measure of personalization quality.
